script_text:
Stop! Pisces, the stars are screaming at you right now, today.
Neptune, your modern ruling planet, is in Aries in your 2nd House of money, opposing Venus in Libra in your 8th House of shared resources. Your water element makes this opposition feel dreamy, but Jupiter in Leo in your 6th House sextiles Uranus in Gemini in your 4th House, offering a practical work breakthrough.
In love, Venus opposing Neptune can attract an artistic, confusing connection; single Pisces should enjoy the chemistry but verify the facts, and couples must discuss money before intimacy deepens.
For career and money, Jupiter in the 6th House favors a flexible work offer from home, while Neptune in the 2nd House warns against vague pay promises.
Avoid signing any financial agreement before reading the fine print; an unexpected gift arrives through a trusted coworker.
Follow for tomorrow's reading.
